claim_assessments.reason: The method prioritizes remote nodes by their connections to the local subgraph, predicts embeddings for selected high-importance nodes, and uses historical embeddings for the remainder; a sampling_ratio controls selection.
The pipeline has Stale Epochs that skip physical boundary-node communication and Sync Epochs in which the GPU sends fresh remote-worker embeddings to the DPU for subsequent prediction.
The reuse method uses trend accumulators and feeds predicted values into the historical record or ring-buffer state when observations are unavailable.
